exposure: not having received the BCG vaccine
not belonging to the mountain region
cohort: The study participants were children under five years of age in Peru.
finding: The hepatitis B vaccination rate in Peruvian children under five was 91.9%, with place of delivery, cesarean delivery, lack of BCG vaccination, and not belonging to the mountain region identified as factors associated with non-vaccination.
mod_finding: Cesarean births were identified as a factor associated with non-vaccination against hepatitis B.
